text: hey something is wrong with this color wheel  for the color picker in the game tooling [Image #1]
resolution: Fixed the color wheel dead-black state in the shared hmsc-int paint ColorWheel component. The wheel shader now renders hue/saturation at full brightness instead of multiplying the wheel by the current value, so selecting #000000 no longer makes the whole wheel black. A wheel pick from true black also lifts value to full brightness so clicking the wheel actually chooses a usable color. Verification: the paint suite passed during game verify, and hmsc-int bundling succeeded before the native Zig step hit the unrelated Zig cache manifest_create error. Commit was interrupted before completion, so no SHA is attached.
